svg.title: Step 4 polish 06: the storyboard builder on a phone at 390 px
svg.text: 06 · The storyboard builder on a phone (390 px)
The same builder in one column, in three parts the organiser moves between: Overview, Round, Preview. Book shot O29.

g.text: A tournament or ceremony item starts
Until the item starts · finale It’s on!
Orders close at 20:00 · Lost and found at the info desk · Grand final on stage tonight
Every round ends: the item starts
By hand has no item: the place reads “the stage”
Countdown 20 s ≥ 9 s for its words

svg.text: Overview
Round
Preview
What changed and why
The checks as one line on top
O29 opened with the full Before you save card;
here one line says how many pass and opens
them.
Chips wrap
Triggers and conditions wrap in the column;
nothing is wider than the phone.
The rounds on a short timeline
The same axis as on the desktop, drawn small.
The strip scrolls sideways
Tap a step to open its form below.
One field a row, labels above
On the phone a field takes the column’s width;
on the desktop they sit two to a row (sheet
Preview with scrub
The player at the full width; the scrub bar is
coloured by step.
Test-fire and Save in the pending row
Always one tap away, above the bottom bar
(design decision 5).
